stance_rationale: Forge produced some real artifacts, but the package relies on placeholders for 5-spec Harvey regressions, DSR trial penalty, same-period baseline fairness, lockbox charts, and cost convention. The actual weights are 51 test dates only, collapse to 20-name equal weight, and annualized turnover is about 17.64 versus the hard 6.0 cap.

critical_concerns.description: Declared user path qepm/mailbox/worktask/WT-D20260517_001/weights.csv is absent; the stage artifact has only 51 sig_dates from 2022-01-28 to 2026-03-31, not the promised 124 or role-prompt recommended >=60 schedule. alpha_scores.parquet also has only 51 sig_dates, so the full walk-forward time-series contract is incomplete.

The emitted active weights are exactly 20 names at 0.05 on every date: HHI=0.05 and active_weight_unique=1 for all 51 dates. This is an EW collapse, not demonstrated ML sizing, and it invalidates the claimed AX-007 exemption despite alpha_score dispersion.

Harvey 5-spec evidence is a placeholder: CAPM, FF3, FF5, Carhart4, and FF6 all repeat the same one-sample Newey-West mean t-stat, with the package explicitly saying full regressions are deferred. This fails the 5-spec Harvey gate.

DSR uses n_trials=1 in decision_gates_measurement.json even though alpha plus optimizer candidates imply at least 8 trials, and alpha-stage protocol previously discussed 100 trial deflation. Baseline DSR penalty is not recomputed either.

Baseline comparison is documented-baseline based, not same-period recomputed. same_harness_comparison.json uses STR_1715 255-month admit metrics and states same-period overlap is deferred/proxy, so G5 cost-Pareto is unfair.

Cost convention is inconsistent with the optimizer disposition: forge_artifacts_builder.R subtracts 0.0015 × turnover, not 0.0015 × 2 × one-way turnover. Independently, realized turnover annualized from the emitted schedule is about 17.64, far above the hard 6.0 limit.

No equity_curve.png, annual_returns.png, oos_zoom_chart.png, or scenario_comparison.png exists under the WT artifact paths. Lockbox visibility after 2024-01 cannot be visually verified, so RF-F3 and RF-F8 remain open.

Rationalization and placeholder language is still material: full 5-spec is deferred, same-period baseline is TBD, STR_1715 correlation is a weights proxy, and the forge challenge note remains a TBD template. This is No Silent Override incomplete for Forge.

supporting_arguments: Pure-function hashes in forge_package_draft.json match current alpha_package.json, risk_package.json, and optimization_package.json.
Basic emitted per-row constraints pass on the stage weights: 20 active names, long-only, max weight 0.05, and sum weight error about 1.49e-08.
covariance.parquet is PSD on the emitted 20-name matrices: 51 sig_dates, min eigenvalue about 0.0051, max condition number about 27.60, and no cond>100 breaches.
The package does not hide poor headline performance: SR=-0.3396, MDD=0.6545, CAGR=-0.0934, and G1/G3/G4/G5 are marked fail.
unresolved_disputes: Whether stage_artifacts/WT_D20260517_001 may substitute for the user-specified qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260517_001 and mailbox weights paths.
Whether an equal-weight collapsed DPL schedule can qualify as AX-007 ML sizing.
Whether 51 test-only sig_dates can satisfy the promised walk-forward package despite missing 124-sig_date emission.
Whether same-period STR_1715 metrics and DSR penalty can be deferred past Forge.
weakest_assumption: The weakest assumption is that a Forge package with EW-collapsed weights and placeholder/proxy validation can be treated as a completed DPL walk-forward verification artifact.
rebuttal_required: Emit the requested mailbox weights.csv or reconcile artifact paths, with >=60 preferably 124 sig_dates and schedule-level turnover.
Re-train or fix projection/export so weights demonstrate non-degenerate ML sizing rather than 20 x 5% EW.
Run real CAPM, Carhart-3, Carhart-4, KR FF5 v2, and FF6 regressions with distinct t_NW, alpha_monthly, and DSR outputs.
Recompute DSR with the correct candidates_tried/n_trials and apply the same penalty to baseline.
Recompute STR_1715 baseline on the exact same period, cost, return convention, and DSR penalty.
Apply the round-trip cost convention or explicitly prove turnover is already round-trip; address turnover >600% annual hard fail.
Emit lockbox/equity, annual returns, OOS zoom, and scenario comparison charts.

Full 5-spec FF regressions deferred to Judge stage
